name: Quick Quiz
description: Test your general and programming knowledge against a 15-second clock.

name: Tic Tac Toe
description: Challenge the smart computer AI in the classic 3x3 strategy battle.

name: Memory Match
description: Flip and match all 8 hidden pairs with minimum moves and seconds.

name: Guess It
description: Find the secret hidden number between 1 and 100 with fewer attempts.

name: Snake Arcade
description: Navigate the growing snake, eat golden apples, and avoid walls.

name: Whack-a-Mole
description: Fast-paced reflex test! Whack moles, avoid bombs, and build combos.

name: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Battle the AI in a Best-of-5 tournament series with bonus victory points.

name: Space Dodger
description: Pilot your spaceship through asteroid fields and collect powerup stars.

name: 2048 Puzzle
description: Slide matching number tiles across the 4x4 grid to create the 2048 tile.

name: Typing Speed Test
description: Measure your words per minute (WPM) and typing accuracy against the clock.
